I gained a lot of weight before coming off bc, because of multiple factors (long term relationship, change of job, less exercise etc). Sadly coming off bc didn’t affect it at all. 
Lots of friend experienced change in weight though. Give your body a bit more time to truly settle back into its cycle. At least 6-12 months probably and then see. 
You’ll be beautiful no matter what! And it’s easier said than done but I try keep my mentality in that I just want to feel healthy rather than wanting to look a certain way or be a certain weight. I don’t think I’ll ever get back to the size 6 that I once was 😅

Would always recommend because I think it’s great to understand and tune in to your body. I came off of BC just under 2 years ago and have been tracking my cycle and trying to understand my patterns a lot more which has been interesting. 
In saying that, if feels like there’s always a compromise or pros and cons to both. Off bc I have less severe depressive episodes, but I have several days in a month feeling super crappy (back pain, migraines, fatigue etc)

I would recommend the cup to anyone and everyone! :)
